editorial:
Imagine two of the dumbest teenagers ever created suddenly losing their favorite thing in the world: their TV. That is how you get swept into the chaotic world of these two slackers who just want to sit on a couch and laugh at music videos. The vibe here is totally mindless and loud, which is exactly why it works. You get to watch these two idiots wander across the country without a clue, somehow managing to cause massive disasters everywhere they go. It feels like a fever dream where everything that can go wrong does go wrong, and the humor comes from how completely oblivious the main characters are to the danger around them.

What really makes this trip a blast is the pacing; it never slows down because the plot keeps throwing them into wilder situations. While the humor is pretty crude and simple, it is great for when you just want to turn your brain off. If you are a fan of stupid comedies, you should definitely check this out. It is the perfect movie to put on when you have friends over and just want to laugh at some nonsense.
endingExplained: After accidentally starting a national panic, the duo ends up in a huge showdown with the government. They manage to ruin the villain's evil plan not because they are smart, but because they are too dumb to follow orders. In the end, they get their TV back and return to their couch. They are totally unchanged by the trip, proving that no matter how far they travel, they will always be lazy slackers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mindless humor and adult animation.
